issue.title: Fix quarkus.test.arg-line multiple args handling
issue.body:
The split is intended to happen on a whitespace character,
not the comma character used to denote multiple values in application.properties

Fixes: #19623

body: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/19641 should fix the issue but it's probably too late to get it into `2.2.0.Final`, which means it will likely be available from `2.2.1.Final`
Thanks @geoand for responding on this one. I'll try it again on 2.2.1.Final. ;-)
